message.ghostrunner.ascended: §bThe mortal shell is broken, the soul reforged into a blade. Welcome, Ghostrunner.
message.ghostrunner.already_ascended: §eYou are no longer 'you'. There is no need, nor possibility, for another modification.
item.ghostrunner.ghostrunner_tag.tip: §7Strip away your mortal flesh, and reforge your consciousness into a blade.*Right-click to modify yourself into a Ghostrunner.
item.ghostrunner.ghostrunner_tag.detail: §cWarning: The modification process involves severe physiological shock (reduces health to 1 point).*§cPlease use in a safe environment to avoid being ambushed by mobs during blindness.*§8—— 'Do not resist, this is just a system upgrade.'
